### 🐛 Describe the bug PR [#36787](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/36787) moved Gemma's `sqrt(hidden_size)` normalization from `forward()` into text-only `embed_input_ids()`, but PaliGemma retained the inverse scale that previously compensated for the old common forward multiplication. Current vLLM consequently feeds projected image features into Gemma at `1 / sqrt(hidden_size)` of their intended magnitude. Before #36787, the operations were balanced: ```text text: embed_tokens ------------------------> Gemma.forward * sqrt(H) image: projector / sqrt(H) -> merge --------> Gemma.forward * sqrt(H) ``` After #36787, current vLLM scales only text: ```text text: embed_tokens * sqrt(H) -> merge -> Gemma.forward unchanged image: projector / sqrt(H) ----> merge -> Gemma.forward unchanged ``` Current `main` scales text in [`gemma.py:284-308`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/60c3a31b12b0a735baa79684885391747771ec64/vllm/model_executor/models/gemma.py#L284-L308), but still inverse-scales images in [`paligemma.py:376-383`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/60c3a31b12b0a735baa79684885391747771ec64/vllm/model_executor/models/paligemma.py#L376-L383). Multimodal merge only replaces placeholder rows, and `GemmaModel.forward(inputs_embeds=...)` applies no compensating scale. Transformers changed both halves atomically in [`0e7cb4e3`](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/commit/0e7cb4e3ea3daaeef626148522f80b751e9559bd): Gemma text lookup gained `sqrt(H)` scaling and PaliGemma stopped dividing projected image features. Transformers 5.14.1 directly inserts raw projected image features into the already-scaled text embeddings. For ColPali's `hidden_size=2048`, the contract reduction is: ```python import math hidden_size = 2048 raw_projected_image = 1.0 print( "before #36787:", raw_projected_image * hidden_size**-0.5 * math.sqrt(hidden_size), ) print("current vLLM:", raw_projected_image * hidden_size**-0.5) print("expected:", raw_projected_image) ``` ```text before #36787: 1.0 current vLLM: 0.022097086912079608 expected: 1.0 ``` The stale factor is therefore about `0.0221`: projected image features enter Gemma at about 2.21% of their intended magnitude. Controlled one-variable A/B against the pinned Transformers reference: | Variant | Text cosine mean | Image cosine mean | Image p01 | Image minimum | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Current stale inverse scale | 0.999797 | 0.903149 | 0.430221 | 0.225688 | | Inverse scale removed only | 0.999797 | 0.987502 | 0.726556 | 0.436249 | The request, preprocessing, checkpoint, plugin SHA, and reference were held constant; only `vision_embeddings *= hidden_size**-0.5` was removed. The remaining image mismatch is a separately measured Neuron eager-vision drift, so this one-line change should not be represented as fixing all ColPali parity issues. Full ColPali command used for validation: ```bash vllm serve vidore/colpali-v1.3-hf \ --revision 7d3c8ab1c1908b32d701308fb1dfb2968d150c67 \ --served-model-name vidore/colpali-v1.3-hf \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 \ --max-num-seqs 1 \ --max-model-len 4096 \ --trust-remote-code \ --runner pooling \ --convert none \ --pooler-config.task token_embed \ --port 20000 ``` Expected behavior: PaliGemma should return raw projected image features from `embed_multimodal()`, matching Transformers' scaled-text/raw-image contract. Suggested fix: ```diff def embed_multimodal(self, **kwargs: object) -> MultiModalEmbeddings: image_input = self._parse_and_validate_image_input(**kwargs) if image_input is None: return [] vision_embeddings = self._process_image_input(image_input) - vision_embeddings = vision_embeddings * (self.config.hidden_size**-0.5) return vision_embeddings ``` Suggested tests: pass known projected `image_embeds` to PaliGemma and assert they are returned unchanged; add one fixed-image Transformers parity test that compares first-step logits or top-k probabilities. Current ColPali tests verify shape, L2 normalization, and weak relevance ordering, which cannot detect this pre-language-model scaling error. The final downstream ColPali branch passes with pristine vLLM only because its host-vision path supplies raw projected features and bypasses `PaliGemma.embed_multimodal()`. The one-line patch is not part of that final plugin apply set, and the pristine pass does not validate the stale upstream method. This regression was introduced by #36787 (`65986db6ba71abf4cf0639c5fd1477b0d8df8f5e`). Searches for PaliGemma image scaling, inverse scaling, `sqrt(hidden_size)`, `hidden_size**-0.5`, and #36787 found no matching issue or follow-up fix. Severity: major silent correctness regression. The source contract is confirmed; broad current-main CUDA generation impact has not yet been quantified. ### Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
